metadata.description: Evidence-first engineering for teams of AI agents: composable skill facets, measuring tools, and one append-only journal.

plugins.name: facetkit
plugins.description: Skills as composable facets, a nine-agent team and three commands; the `facet` command comes from npm (npm i -g facetkit).

plugins.name: viz-flow
plugins.description: The same method for architectural visualization (Archicad → Blender → renders → website images): briefs with checkable criteria, five cheap agents, measured stage checks. Self-contained: Python scripts, no npm.

plugins.name: arch-flow
plugins.description: The same method for architectural production in Archicad: sources into a checked model description, the description into a model on the right layers, complete drawing sets, and a schedule with quantified risk. Self-contained: Python tools, no npm.
